caveat: When operated in FIPS mode. This module contains the embedded module eToken 5105 validated to FIPS 140-2 under Cert. #1883 operating in FIPS mode. No assurance of the minimum strength of generated keys
description: DocuSign HSM Appliance is a high-performance cryptographic service provider. It performs high-speed cryptographic operations while protecting sensitive data. Its features include Triple-DES, AES, CCM, HMAC, RSA, ECDSA, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, public key database and certificate support, authenticated and encrypted communication with the module, secure storage of secret/private keys, software key medium and smartcard support, tamper-responsive enclosure, high level API requiring no cryptographic expertise, in-depth logging and auditing, and secure backup capabilities.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
